info.name: QueueStorm Investigator — /analyze-ticket
info.description: Local test collection for the QueueStorm Investigator hackathon endpoint. Covers 10 sample cases (SAMPLE-01..10) + 10 adversarial cases (TEST-011..020). Set the baseUrl variable (default http://localhost:3000) and run a folder.

item.name: Sample Pack (SAMPLE-01 → SAMPLE-10)
SAMPLE-01 — Wrong transfer with matching evidence

body.raw:
{
  "ticket_id": "TKT-001",
  "complaint": "I sent 5000 taka to a wrong number around 2pm today. The number was supposed to be 01712345678 but I think I typed it wrong. The person isn't responding to my call. Please help me get my money back.",
  "language": "en",
  "channel": "in_app_chat",
  "user_type": "customer",
  "campaign_context": "boishakh_bonanza_day_1",
  "transaction_history": [
    {
      "transaction_id": "TXN-9101",
      "timestamp": "2026-04-14T14:08:22Z",
      "type": "transfer",
      "amount": 5000,
      "counterparty": "+8801719876543",
      "status": "completed"
    },
    {
      "transaction_id": "TXN-9087",
      "timestamp": "2026-04-13T18:12:00Z",
      "type": "cash_in",
      "amount": 10000,
      "counterparty": "AGENT-512",
      "status": "completed"
    }
  ]
}

request.description: Wrong transfer with matching evidence

exec: pm.test('NO refund promises', () => pm.expect(/\b(will refund|refunded|reversed your|money back|guarantee reversal|refund processed|unblock your)\b/i.test(reply)).to.eql(false));
// === Log full response for visual inspection ===
